stories.label: Iran crisis — Tehran rejects 'limited strike' concept as Feb 26 talks approach
stories.summary: Iran FM spokesperson explicitly rejects 'limited strike' concept: 'There is no limited strike. An act of aggression would be regarded as an act of aggression.' Witkoff says Trump wonders why Iran hasn't 'capitulated.' India advising nationals to leave. Feb 26 talks confirmed by Iran/Oman but not US. Diplomatic window narrowing.

stories.label: Mexico post-El Mencho — CJNG revenge attacks continue across 20+ states
stories.summary: CJNG revenge attacks continue across 20+ states. White House confirmed providing intelligence support for the operation. Tourists trapped. Airlines canceled flights. Not selected this cycle — covered recently, watch for cartel fragmentation dynamics.

stories.label: Israel advances death penalty bill that UN says discriminates against Palestinians
stories.summary: Knesset debating death penalty bill. Only one execution in Israeli history (Eichmann, 1962). UN Human Rights Council says bill violates right to life and discriminates against Palestinians. Pushed by far-right coalition.

stories.label: Hong Kong 47: Appeals court upholds all convictions in largest national security trial
stories.summary: All 12 appeals dismissed. NSL tested at every judicial level and held. Legal architecture for permanent political control established.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia conflict — 4th anniversary Feb 24
stories.summary: 4th anniversary Feb 24. Zelensky accuses Putin of starting WWIII. Russia overnight strikes. Not selected — no concrete new development beyond expected anniversary rhetoric. Prioritize next cycle if diplomatic or military shift emerges.

stories.label: Israeli forces detain 100+ Palestinians in first days of Ramadan
stories.summary: 100+ detained since Ramadan began. Al-Aqsa access blocked. West Bank mosque torched (1,720 settler attacks since Oct 7). 9,300 currently held.

stories.label: 200+ Venezuelan political prisoners launch hunger strike over amnesty exclusions
stories.summary: 200+ political prisoners on hunger strike. Amnesty law excludes military-charge detainees. Performative justice by Maduro regime.

stories.label: Netherlands installs youngest PM Jetten leading minority government
stories.summary: Rob Jetten becomes youngest Dutch PM in history. Minority government installed after Wilders coalition collapse. Counter-signal to European far-right trend.

stories.label: Zambian communities poisoned as Copperbelt mining boom feeds green transition
stories.summary: Mining companies scouring Copperbelt for copper and cobalt used in green energy. Locals face unchecked pollution and contamination. Classic extraction pattern with new commodity.

stories.label: Pakistan warns 7.1M at risk as 13,000 glaciers melt at record pace
stories.summary: Temperatures 3-5°C above normal. Nighttime cooling collapsed. Glacial lake outburst floods imminent. 13,000 glaciers (largest non-polar reservoir), 10,000 receding. 7.1M people vulnerable.

stories.label: Nobel laureate's invention generates 1,000 litres of water from thin air daily
stories.summary: Prof Omar Yaghi's metal-organic frameworks extract clean water from air — up to 1,000 litres/day. Could transform water access for islands and climate-vulnerable communities.

stories.label: Bitcoin miner dumps entire treasury for AI data center pivot
stories.summary: Singapore's Bitdeer sold entire bitcoin treasury for AI data center expansion. Signals broader industry-wide capital strategy shift from crypto mining to AI compute.

stories.label: China's Type 095 nuclear attack submarine confirmed in satellite images
stories.summary: First satellite confirmation of China's next-gen Type 095 nuclear-powered attack submarine.

stories.label: Ghana takes transatlantic slavery case to UN with AU backing
stories.summary: President Mahama with AU endorsement pushing UN recognition of transatlantic slavery as gravest crime against humanity.

stories.label: Marshall Islands launches world's first national UBI via crypto and Starlink
stories.summary: First-ever national UBI via cryptocurrency and Starlink. Climate-vulnerable Pacific nation skipping traditional banking.

stories.label: China builds hi-tech backbone of Africa's space ambitions
stories.summary: Satellite ground station in Namibia, Egyptian lab in orbit, growing continent-wide network of Chinese-funded space facilities.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — collection of illegal tariffs halting Feb 24
stories.summary: CBP stopping collection of SCOTUS-struck tariffs on Feb 24. Trump pivoted to 15% via Section 122. China demanding cancellation. Not selected — no major new development this cycle.

stories.label: Pakistan strikes inside Afghanistan — Taliban vows retaliation
stories.summary: Pakistan claims 70 fighters killed in latest cross-border strikes. Taliban vows retaliation. Afghans mourn civilian dead.

stories.label: First documented victim of AI agent harassment warns of thousands more
stories.summary: First documented case of autonomous AI targeting an individual.

stories.label: Hungary threatens EU Russia sanctions veto over oil shipments
stories.summary: Budapest blocking EU's 20th Russia sanctions package. EU calling on Hungary to stop blocking.

stories.label: Nigeria northwest mass killings and abductions continue
stories.summary: Seven more farmers killed in Plateau (Premium Times). Pattern of northwest violence continuing.

stories.label: US ambassador Huckabee's Biblical Israel expansion claim condemned
stories.summary: Huckabee suggested Israel justified in taking much of Middle East on Biblical grounds. 14+ nations condemned.

stories.label: Magnitude 7+ earthquake strikes Borneo, felt across Southeast Asia
stories.summary: M7+ earthquake off northern Borneo. Strongest in Sabah in 11 years. No tsunami.

stories.label: Quantum computing approaches threshold threatening $440B in early Bitcoin
stories.summary: Nearly 7M BTC including Satoshi's 1M coins use vulnerable early cryptographic standards.

stories.label: Sudan war — genocide declared, no new development
stories.summary: Genocide declared. Museveni hosting Dagalo. No new development in 2+ cycles. Need fresh angle to re-cover.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire collapse
stories.summary: Israeli strikes continue. Ceasefire dead. Fading from coverage.

stories.label: French farming crisis: Paris Agriculture Fair opens without cows
stories.summary: Agriculture Fair without cows for first time. Connected to EU-Mercosur tensions.

stories.label: EU-Mercosur trade deal fracturing
stories.summary: World's largest proposed trade zone fracturing.

stories.label: Somaliland offers US minerals and military base for recognition
stories.summary: Somaliland dangles mineral rights and Red Sea base access to court US recognition.

stories.label: Botnet accidentally destroys I2P privacy network
stories.summary: Botnet took down I2P privacy network. Exposes fragility of decentralized infrastructure.

stories.label: Indonesia confirms bilateral trade deal with Trump
stories.summary: Indonesia secures bilateral deal with Trump amid 15% tariff.

stories.label: IS declares new campaign against Syria's post-Assad government
stories.summary: IS declared new campaign against Sharaa's government.

stories.label: Kim Jong Un re-elected at Workers' Party Congress
stories.summary: Kim re-elected. Xi congratulates. Nuclear advances touted.

stories.label: NASA Artemis II delayed past March
stories.summary: Artemis II pushed from March to at least April.
